### listPlacesNearby

`GET /places/nearby`

Places within a radius, nearest first, each with its distance.

**Authentication:** Optional. Answers without a session; a valid Oxy session may widen what is returned.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latitude` | query | yes | number | -90 to 90 |
| `longitude` | query | yes | number | -180 to 180 |
| `radiusMeters` | query | yes | number | Greater than 0, at most 50000 |
| `capabilities` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list, sent once (`a,b,c`). At most 64 items; `[]` at most 256 characters |
| `categories` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list, sent once (`a,b,c`). At most 64 items; `[]` at most 64 characters, pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+(?:[.][a-z0-9_]+)*$` |
| `limit` | query | no | integer | 1 to 200; default `50` |
| `locale` | query | no | string | At most 35 characters |
| `cursor` | query | no | string | 1 to 512 characters; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` |

**Success response**

- `200`: [`PlaceWithDistancePage`](#placewithdistancepage): a page of [`PlaceWithDistance`](#placewithdistance) (`{ items, nextCursor }`).

| --- | --- |
| `400` | `bad_request` |
| `422` | `validation_failed` |
| `429` | `rate_limited` |
| `500` | `internal_error` |

### search

`GET /search`

The blended search box: GoWay Places and the interactive geocoders.

**Authentication:** Optional. Answers without a session; a valid Oxy session may widen what is returned.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | query | yes | string | 1 to 256 characters |
| `latitude` | query | no | number | -90 to 90 |
| `longitude` | query | no | number | -180 to 180 |
| `west` | query | no | number | -180 to 180 |
| `south` | query | no | number | -90 to 90 |
| `east` | query | no | number | -180 to 180 |
| `north` | query | no | number | -90 to 90 |
| `capabilities` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list, sent once (`a,b,c`). At most 64 items; `[]` at most 256 characters |
| `categories` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list, sent once (`a,b,c`). At most 64 items; `[]` at most 64 characters, pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+(?:[.][a-z0-9_]+)*$` |
| `limit` | query | no | integer | 1 to 50 |
| `locale` | query | no | string | At most 35 characters |
| `cursor` | query | no | string | 1 to 512 characters; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` |

**Success response**

- `200`: [`SearchResults`](#searchresults): a page of [`SearchResult`](#searchresult) (`{ items, nextCursor }`).

**Errors**

| Status | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `400` | `bad_request` |
| `422` | `validation_failed` |
| `429` | `rate_limited` |
| `500` | `internal_error` |
| `503` | `provider_unavailable`, `service_unavailable` |

| Operation | Method and path | Authentication |

### getDirections

`POST /routes`

Directions between two or more points. An empty `routes` is a normal answer.

**Authentication:** Optional. Answers without a session; a valid Oxy session may widen what is returned.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required): `RouteRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | object | yes |  |
| `origin.coordinate` | object | no |  |
| `origin.coordinate.latitude` | number | yes | -90 to 90 |
| `origin.coordinate.longitude` | number | yes | -180 to 180 |
| `origin.placeId` | string | no | 1 to 128 characters |
| `origin.name` | string | no | At most 200 characters |
| `destination` | object | yes |  |
| `destination.coordinate` | object | no |  |
| `destination.coordinate.latitude` | number | yes | -90 to 90 |
| `destination.coordinate.longitude` | number | yes | -180 to 180 |
| `destination.placeId` | string | no | 1 to 128 characters |
| `destination.name` | string | no | At most 200 characters |
| `waypoints` | array of object | no | At most 8 items |
| `waypoints[].coordinate` | object | no |  |
| `waypoints[].coordinate.latitude` | number | yes | -90 to 90 |
| `waypoints[].coordinate.longitude` | number | yes | -180 to 180 |
| `waypoints[].placeId` | string | no | 1 to 128 characters |
| `waypoints[].name` | string | no | At most 200 characters |
| `mode` | string | yes | 1 to 32 characters |
| `alternatives` | boolean | no |  |
| `locale` | string | no | At most 35 characters |
| `vehicle` | object | no |  |
| `vehicle.user` | one of `"car"`, `"taxi"`, `"van"`, `"hgv"`, `"bus"`, `"motorcycle"`, `"moped"` | no | Default `"car"` |
| `vehicle.fuel` | one of `"petrol"`, `"diesel"`, `"hybrid"`, `"plug_in_hybrid"`, `"electric"`, `"hydrogen"`, `"lpg"`, `"cng"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.standard` | one of `"euro_1"`, `"euro_2"`, `"euro_3"`, `"euro_4"`, `"euro_5"`, `"euro_6"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.electricRangeKm` | number | no | 0 to 2000 |
| `vehicle.labels` | object | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.es_dgt` | one of `"0"`, `"eco"`, `"c"`, `"b"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.fr_critair` | one of `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"4"`, `"5"`, `"e"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.de_plakette` | one of `"green"`, `"yellow"`, `"red"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.uk_ulez` | one of `"compliant"`, `"non_compliant"` | no |  |
| `exclude` | array of one of `"toll"`, `"motorway"`, `"ferry"` | no | At most 3 items |
| `departureAt` | string (date-time) | no | At least 1 character |

**Success response**

- `200`: [`RouteResponse`](#routeresponse).

**Errors**

| Status | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `400` | `bad_request` |
| `404` | `not_found` |
| `422` | `validation_failed`, `no_route`, `unsupported_mode` |
| `429` | `rate_limited` |
| `500` | `internal_error` |
| `503` | `provider_unavailable`, `service_unavailable` |

| `source` | one of `"camera"`, `"library"`, `"guided_session"` | yes |  |
| `contentHash` | string | yes | Pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `byteSize` | integer | yes | Greater than 0 |
| `contentType` | string | yes | At most 120 characters |
| `capturedAt` | string (date-time) | no | At least 1 character |
| `location` | array of object | yes | 1 to 4 items |
| `location[].origin` | one of `"device_capture"`, `"media_metadata"`, `"user_placed"` | yes |  |
| `location[].coordinate` | object | no |  |
| `location[].coordinate.latitude` | number | yes | -90 to 90 |
| `location[].coordinate.longitude` | number | yes | -180 to 180 |
| `location[].exifGps` | object | no |  |
| `location[].exifGps.latitude` | object | yes |  |
| `location[].exifGps.longitude` | object | yes |  |
| `location[].exifGps.altitude` | number | no | At least 0 |
| `location[].exifGps.altitudeRef` | one of `0`, `1` | no |  |
| `location[].exifGps.imageDirection` | number | no |  |
| `location[].accuracyMeters` | number | no | 0 to 100000 |
| `location[].altitudeMeters` | number | no | -12000 to 12000 |
| `location[].headingDegrees` | number | no | 0 to 360 |
| `location[].observedAt` | string (date-time) | no | At least 1 character |
| `camera` | object | no |  |
| `camera.widthPixels` | integer | no | Greater than 0, at most 1000000 |
| `camera.heightPixels` | integer | no | Greater than 0, at most 1000000 |
| `camera.exifOrientation` | integer | no |  |
| `camera.focalLengthMm` | number | no | Greater than 0, at most 10000 |
| `camera.focalLength35mm` | number | no | Greater than 0, at most 10000 |
| `camera.make` | string | no | At most 120 characters |
| `camera.model` | string | no | At most 120 characters |
| `camera.lens` | string | no | At most 120 characters |
| `camera.durationSeconds` | number | no | Greater than 0, at most 86400 |
| `camera.frameRate` | number | no | Greater than 0, at most 1000 |
| `motion` | object | no |  |
| `motion.orientation` | one of `"portrait"`, `"portraitUpsideDown"`, `"landscapeLeft"`, `"landscapeRight"` | yes |  |
| `motion.samples` | array of object | yes | 1 to 14400 items |
| `motion.samples[].t` | number | yes | 0 to 86400 |
| `motion.samples[].gravity` | [number, number, number] | yes |  |

**Success response**

- `201`: [`CaptureUploadTicket`](#captureuploadticket).

| Status | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `400` | `bad_request` |
| `401` | `unauthorized` |
| `403` | `forbidden` |
| `404` | `not_found` |
| `409` | `conflict` |
| `413` | `payload_too_large` |
| `422` | `validation_failed` |
| `429` | `rate_limited` |
| `500` | `internal_error` |
| `503` | `service_unavailable` |

### withdrawCaptureAsset

`DELETE /captures/assets/{assetId}`

Withdraw a contribution; its media is deleted and it never feeds a scene.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assetId` | path | yes | string | 1 to 128 characters |

- `204`: no content.

| `401` | `unauthorized` |
| `404` | `not_found` |
| `429` | `rate_limited` |
| `500` | `internal_error` |

### evaluateRoadAccess

May this vehicle enter this position now? The strictest decision among the zones covering it, with each zone's verdict. The vehicle is used for this answer and never stored.

| `latitude` | number | yes | -90 to 90 |
| `longitude` | number | yes | -180 to 180 |
| `vehicle` | object | no | Default `{"user":"car"}` |
| `vehicle.user` | one of `"car"`, `"taxi"`, `"van"`, `"hgv"`, `"bus"`, `"motorcycle"`, `"moped"` | no | Default `"car"` |
| `vehicle.fuel` | one of `"petrol"`, `"diesel"`, `"hybrid"`, `"plug_in_hybrid"`, `"electric"`, `"hydrogen"`, `"lpg"`, `"cng"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.standard` | one of `"euro_1"`, `"euro_2"`, `"euro_3"`, `"euro_4"`, `"euro_5"`, `"euro_6"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.electricRangeKm` | number | no | 0 to 2000 |
| `vehicle.labels` | object | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.es_dgt` | one of `"0"`, `"eco"`, `"c"`, `"b"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.fr_critair` | one of `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"4"`, `"5"`, `"e"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.de_plakette` | one of `"green"`, `"yellow"`, `"red"`, `"none"` | no |  |
| `vehicle.labels.uk_ulez` | one of `"compliant"`, `"non_compliant"` | no |  |
| `at` | string (date-time) | no | At least 1 character |

**Success response**

- `200`: [`RoadAccessDecision`](#roadaccessdecision).

**Errors**

| Status | Codes |
| --- | --- |
